app.name: Pipedrive

verdict.headline: Pipedrive requires formal Marketplace review for public OAuth apps, with waiting times often exceeding two months.
verdict.summary: Developers must sign up for a developer sandbox account, create a Public App in the Developer Hub, configure the OAuth settings, and submit it for review. While Pipedrive officially states reviews take up to 21 business days, community reports show actual review times frequently cross two months. Access tokens expire in 60 minutes, and refresh tokens expire in 60 days if unused.

handsOnEffort.label: 2–4 hours
handsOnEffort.basis: Developer sandbox signup, Developer Hub app creation, callback URL configuration, and scope mapping.

timeToFirstConnection.label: 1–2 hours
timeToFirstConnection.basis: Instant sandbox account creation and private app setup for self-testing.

timeToProduction.label: 4–8 weeks
timeToProduction.basis: Pipedrive states public app reviews take up to 21 business days; developers report waiting 2+ months.

verdict.longestPole: Formal Pipedrive Marketplace review queue and approval process
verdict.costDetail: Developer sandbox accounts and public app creation are free of charge.

easierPaths.effect: Use a private app with a direct unlisted installation link to bypass the Marketplace review queue.

factors.detail: Developers can sign up and create a public or private app instantly via the Developer Hub.
Public apps must pass formal Pipedrive Marketplace review before any arbitrary user can connect.
Standard developer registration does not require formal legal business verification documentation.
No mandatory third-party security audit or penetration test is required for standard marketplace apps.
Creating developer accounts and registering apps in the Developer Hub is free.
No sales gate or partner manager approval is needed to start building and submitting apps.
Arbitrary external users cannot connect until the public app passes Marketplace review; private apps bypass this via unlisted installation links.
Centralized OAuth credentials are used for all connected user workspaces.

phases.title: Create Developer Sandbox & App
phases.outcome: A registered Pipedrive public app with a Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Sign up for a Developer Sandbox account
steps.details: Go to developers.pipedrive.com and sign up for a free developer sandbox account to access the Developer Hub.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can verify the portal is reachable and provide sign-up link references.

steps.title: Create a new Public App in the Developer Hub
steps.details: Navigate to **Settings → Developer Hub**, click **Create app**, select **Public App**, and fill in your basic app details (App name, single OAuth callback URL).
steps.agentAssist: An agent can draft your app name, description, and configuration values based on your project requirements.

phases.title: Configure OAuth Settings & Scopes
phases.outcome: Redirect URI and necessary permission scopes mapped correctly in your Pipedrive app.

steps.title: Set the Composio Redirect URI
steps.details: In your app configuration under **OAuth & access**, enter the Composio callback URL: `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can supply the exact callback URL string for you to copy and paste.

steps.title: Select required scopes
steps.details: In **OAuth & access scopes**, select `deals:full` and `contacts:full` to grant access to read/write deals and contacts.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can generate a list of required scopes and justifications needed for your app's intended workflows.

phases.title: Submit for Marketplace Review
phases.outcome: App submitted to Pipedrive for formal review queue entry.

steps.title: Submit app for review
steps.details: Review all app details, verify the privacy policy URL and terms of service, and click **Submit for Review** in the Developer Hub.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can review your checklist of required submission fields and draft responses for review questions.

steps.title: Wait for Pipedrive Marketplace approval
steps.details: Pipedrive officially states public app reviews take up to 21 business days, but community reports show real-world times exceeding two months.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can monitor status check intervals or draft follow-up messages for support.

phases.title: Go Live in Composio
phases.outcome: Pipedrive custom OAuth configured and active inside Composio.

steps.title: Create custom OAuth config in Composio
steps.details: Go to the Composio dashboard, create a custom Pipedrive auth configuration, and paste your Pipedrive Client ID and Client Secret.
steps.agentAssist: An agent using the Composio API can create the custom auth config if provided with your credentials.

steps.title: Start connection and enter Pipedrive subdomain
steps.details: Initiate the user connection flow from Composio and enter your Pipedrive subdomain when prompted.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can trigger the connection flow programmatically via the Composio SDK/API.

requirements.detail: Required to access developers.pipedrive.com and use the Developer Hub.
Basic app info, single OAuth callback URL, and scope selection configured in the Developer Hub.
Must be set to https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback in the app settings.

scopes.purpose: Full read and write access to deals and pipelines.
Full read and write access to contacts and organizations.

blockers.title: App not found error during connection
blockers.symptom: Pipedrive returns an 'App not found' message when attempting to authenticate.
blockers.howToProceed: Ensure the app has passed Marketplace review or use an approved app. Verify that the Client ID and Secret in Composio match your Pipedrive Developer Hub app configuration.

blockers.title: Extended review wait times
blockers.symptom: App remains stuck in review status past the 21 business day window.
blockers.howToProceed: Check the Pipedrive developer community forums or contact Pipedrive developer support for review status updates.

blockers.title: Incorrect redirect flow using 'Install and Test'
blockers.symptom: Authentication callback fails or lacks Composio context when clicking buttons inside Pipedrive app settings.
blockers.howToProceed: Do not click 'Install and Test' inside Pipedrive's OAuth app settings. Always start the connection flow directly from Composio.

nuances.title: Token Lifetimes
nuances.detail: Access tokens expire in 60 minutes, while refresh tokens expire in 60 days if unused, with their expiry resetting on each use.

nuances.title: Private vs Public Apps
nuances.detail: Private apps use an unlisted direct installation link and bypass Marketplace review, whereas public apps require formal review.

steps: Navigate to the Composio dashboard and select the Pipedrive toolkit.
Create a new custom auth configuration using your Pipedrive Client ID and Client Secret.
Verify the redirect URI is set to `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` in your Pipedrive Developer Hub.
Initiate the connection flow from Composio and enter your Pipedrive subdomain.
